capabilities: make a presentation from a note or selection
find and open a note's presentation in a browser
download presentations as PowerPoint or PDF
edit presentations by hand in the Synclo web app
disambiguation: Despite the name, this is not a sync tool; it generates and exports presentations from notes.
extras: Freemium: new accounts get 400 free credits (~40 slides); generating presentations then requires a paid plan, while manual editing, opening, finding and downloading stay free. The README details privacy: only the chosen note, its embeds and options are sent to synclo.app and AI subprocessors, with a preview before sending.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into designed presentations or export them as PowerPoint or PDF files.

requires.name: Synclo paid plan or credit pack

summary: Cloud-based presentation generator that turns notes into designed slide decks and downloads them as PowerPoint or PDF.
